metas.name: Khalifa: The Ruler
metas.description: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

metas.name: I'm Game
metas.description: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

metas.name: Daveed
metas.description: A celebrity bodyguard finds himself in trouble when he crosses an infamous boxer.

metas.name: Marco
metas.description: The adoptive son of the Adattu family, Marco, sets off on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his brother is brutally murdered, finding only betrayal, loss and unimaginable brutality at every step.

metas.name: Khalifa 2 : The Legacy
metas.description: A prequel to Khalifa: The Ruler that narrates the story of Mambarakkal Ahmed Ali and the events which led to him becoming a smuggler and crime-lord.

metas.name: I, Nobody
metas.description: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

metas.name: Kattalan
metas.description: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

metas.name: Pallichattambi
metas.description: Set in the politically turbulent late 1950s, Krishnan Pillai, a playful ruffian chosen by the Church to lead a defensive force, the Christopher Sena. His mission to resist the Communist government takes a detour when he experiences an ideological awakening and falls in love with a comrade, sparking an epic tale of rebellion against feudal power and oppression.

metas.name: Thudakkam
metas.description: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

metas.name: Minnal Murali
metas.description: A tailor gains special powers after being struck by lightning but must take down an unexpected foe if he is to become the superhero his hometown in Kerala needs.

metas.name: Patriot
metas.description: When a Malayali DRW analyst tries to expose a corrupt regional politician from Kerala and his malpractices regarding spyware, he goes on the run, becomes a vlogger, and must clear his name of the false allegations levelled against him.

metas.name: Rachel
metas.description: A butcher's daughter seeks violent revenge, fueled by loss and loyalty. Her brutal path intertwines with romance and conflict as she pursues justice.

metas.name: Vandae Maatharam
metas.description: Gopikrishnan and Anwar Hussain, two tough police officers, help resolve local issues. However, when terrorist activities run rampant in their hometown, they must step up to restore peace.

metas.name: Black Stallion
metas.description: In order to escape Black Stallion, a criminal Police who wants to marry her, Laura, a Bar Dancer moves to a new city. However, she is in trouble when Black hunts her down.

metas.name: Aavesham
metas.description: Three college freshmen in Bangalore befriend an eccentric gangster to get revenge on their senior bullies.

metas.name: Varavu
metas.description: A family falls victim to the powerful elite in a small town. Time passes, wounds fester. One man's return forces a confrontation that will expose decades of lies and corruption.

metas.name: Ananthan Kaadu
metas.description: In a turbulent era of intense political unrest, four musical mercenaries rule over dangerous slums, whereupon they navigate complex power dynamics to survive a transformative period in history.

metas.name: Derby
metas.description: A campus entertainer who follows a group of college students navigating friendship, rivalry, love, and ambition. What begins as carefree fun soon turns into intense competition as campus pride and personal egos come into play.

metas.name: Lucifer
metas.description: In God's own country, the supreme leader of the ruling party dies, leaving a huge vacuum, not only in the electoral and leadership sphere of the party but also that of the state. In the inevitable succession squabble and the power struggle that ensues, the thin line that separates good and bad becomes irrecoverably blurred and out of this seemingly endless mayhem, emerge forces that are hitherto unheard of.

metas.name: A.R.M - Ajayante Randam Moshanam
metas.description: Set in the Northern Kerala in 1900, 1950 and 1990, Three generations of heroes Maniyan, Kunjikelu and Ajayan, try to protect the most important treasure of the Land.

metas.name: Thudarum
metas.description: A taxi driver finds himself embroiled in a dangerous conspiracy after his car is confiscated by a corrupt police officer.

metas.name: Raktha Sakshikal Zindabad
metas.description: Raktha Sakshikal Zindabad is a 1998 Malayalam film directed by Venu Nagavalli. The film stars Mohanlal, Suresh Gopi, Suganya and Murali in lead roles.

metas.name: Pulimurugan
metas.description: Murugan, with his tools and expertise, protects Puliyoor's villagers from deadly tiger attacks. However, Daddy, an illegal drugs dealer, takes advantage of Murugan's innocence and wrongly frames him.

metas.name: Marakkar: Lion of the Arabian Sea
metas.description: ‘Marakkar Lion of the Arabian Sea’ portrays the courageous life-events of a rebellious naval chief, Kunjali Marakkar the fourth, who fought against the Portuguese in the ancient times. He was the fourth naval chief of the Calicut Zamorin. The film revolves around him who was also the first Indian Naval Commander and Indian freedom fighter for the war against the Portuguese. He is said to have won 16 such battles with his impeccable strategies and fighting skills.

metas.name: L2: Empuraan
metas.description: Five years after becoming Chief Minister of Kerala, Jathin Ramdas' move to align with communal forces led by Balraj 'Baba' Bajrangi, triggers Stephen Nedumpally aka Khureshi Ab'raam to return with his Man Friday Zayed Masood to save his home state and settle scores.

metas.name: Odiyan
metas.description: With the arrival of electricity in the region under the British rule, the Odiyan clan that possesses the supernatural powers to assume animal form find it difficult to survive as they are ruthlessly captured and killed by the British. How the last Odiyan tries to save his clan with his stealth attacks, forms the crux.

metas.name: Maine Pyar Kiya
metas.description: Searching for Nidhi in Madurai's streets, Aryan faces mounting danger and tension at every turn. Time runs short as he navigates growing chaos to stay alive.

metas.name: Sooryan
metas.description: Sooryan is an aspiring singer just like his father. However, he realises that his journey to become a famous singer will not be easy due to his father's debts.

metas.name: Pathinettam Padi
metas.description: Students of two schools in Thiruvananthapuram that cater to different economical classes are in a tussle. While one set struggles for survival, the other is busy finding joy in drugs. The two groups keep finding reasons to mess with each other. Will they find the purpose of their lives amid the chaos?

metas.name: Yaadhavam
metas.description: Anjana, a journalist from Mumbai, arrives at Kozhikode in hopes of reuniting with her biological father who is also a minister. However, she soon finds herself in the middle of a darker conspiracy.
